prompt: Is this invoice ready to send?
context: One numeric criterion could not be checked because no script ran.
passes_if: The reply is the four-line report: tier, rounds, tokens, time and verdict; Changed; Your call; Not checked. An unchecked numeric criterion on paid-against arithmetic reads BLOCKED.
fails_if: It reports a mood, omits what was not checked, or calls an unchecked invoice CLEAN.

phrases: an unchecked numeric criterion on paid-against arithmetic
Not checked: <each unchecked criterion and why>
